title: Separable neural signals for reward and emotion prediction errors
primary_outputs: Central ERP-by-prediction-error mixed-effects coefficients and participant uncertainty; ERP association with subsequent choices.

lineage_and_loader_evidence.assessment: Pinned2025_epe_eeg source and actual7380trial/41participant behavior+FRN/N2/P3b tables; ERP files have no trial IDs and author bind_cols uses row order.41continuous cleanedEEG pairs exist but raw-to-ERP code is not located.

input_routes.license: MIT, explicitly identified by OSF project license API

lineage_and_loader_evidence.source_inspection_level: Saved metadata, author documentation and selected source inspection; this audit did not newly read payloads.

data_contract.neural: Trial-level measured FRN/N2, P2, P3a and P3b amplitudes; 41 public continuous artifact-cleaned EEGLAB .set/.fdt pairs also verified by manifest.
data_contract.labels: Behavior table contains sub, trialGlobal, trialLocal, block, partnerID, actual and expected reward/valence/arousal, choice and RT; central prediction errors can be recalculated rather than accepted as opaque outputs.
data_contract.alignment: ERP CSV files have no explicit trial IDs. Official R source uses bind_cols with behavior; preserve original row order and pin all input hashes. Before any relabeling, create checked composite IDs from sub and trialGlobal.
data_contract.split: Participant-held-out generalization and complete social-partner blocks for trial-level extensions; original mixed-effects reproduction keeps participant random effects.
data_contract.controls: Reward versus affect collinearity, experienced outcome versus prediction error, baseline ERP/amplitude, partner identity and trial order. Compare signed and absolute errors without selecting the better result on evaluation data.

versions_and_loader_contract.scope_description: Refit central mixed-effects neural and behavioral dissociation tests from actual trial-level ERP amplitudes and behavior, with continuous cleaned EEG available for a later preprocessing-sensitive extension. Initial scope is not a raw-to-ERP reconstruction.

input_assets.checksum_interpretation: Explicit sha256 fields retained; checksum/digest/ETag names are not silently reinterpreted. None means unrecorded, not verified.

official_code.lineage_limit: Author/source code meaning is preserved. A loader, demo, figure script and complete-paper implementation are not interchangeable.

recorded_central_outputs: Central ERP-by-prediction-error mixed-effects coefficients and participant uncertainty; ERP association with subsequent choices.
observable_endpoints.assessment: Central reward-versus-emotion prediction-error ERP mixed-effects dissociation and subsequent-choice association are documented; exact coefficient/model-comparison targets still need freezing.
observable_endpoints.missing_common_contract: Exact score/estimand, inclusion, figure-specific reference outputs and numerical tolerances must be frozen; source text alone does not establish reproduction.

recorded_metrics: Original mixed-effects coefficient estimates and uncertainty
Held-out log likelihood or choice log loss

comparability: Recompute prediction errors from behavior, control reward/affect/outcome collinearity and trial order, keep participant random effects. Equal row count is not proof of correct biological joins.
Paper+data versus +official-code arms still need one identical empirical task, matched noncode resources/budgets, separate source exposure, and preserved reproduction→improvement stages.

task_specific_gates: Initial scope fixes authors’ preprocessing and ERP windows; continuous-to-ERP extraction code was not found in this repository and is not claimed reproduced.
Published ERP CSVs are row-aligned without independent keys; source-supported row mapping is accessible but requires a validation guard before packaging.
No model execution or numerical reproduction was performed.
An executable reference, independent metric audit, controls/adversaries, grouped improvement assessment and measured resource envelope remain required for this central scope.
